lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.contract: MapFragment consumes resource-economy callbacks through one atomic automatic notice claim per process across maps/recreation. A full work queue alone is not evidence of low free memory and must not produce a memory notice. MainActivity exposes independent manual status while the current guard reports economy. Manual Retry re-evaluates caches/resources, preserves source data and does not reset the automatic claim; verification acknowledges the notice only outside the dedicated production-delivery memory case.
